planApproval.note: While 'required', /plan-issue stops after posting every plan. After graduation to 'auto', plans for issues carrying any label in alwaysRequiredFor STILL stop for user approval — ADRs are major decisions and the user steers at this altitude. Graduation is proposed via retro PR; the user decides.
planApproval.debtBurn: Issues labelled 'debt-burn' skip plan approval: the issue body IS the plan (triage only applies the label to small, proven, well-scoped work with named files and mechanical acceptance). Anything needing a re-structure or re-think is not labelled debt-burn and keeps the full gates.

merge.autoRule: A PR auto-merges once CI is green iff it contains NO source-code files AND touches nothing under humanAlways paths. Source code = extensions .ts .tsx .js .mjs .cjs .sh .py .tf .sql — files whose structure (functions, modules, components) the user reviews. Markdown, JSON, YAML, and other plain config auto-merge.
merge.codeRule: Human-review PRs: CI green, then label 'awaiting-review', notify the user with a short review guide, do NOT merge; continue with independent tickets while it waits.
merge.note: Propose relaxing via retro PR once review-feedback categories go quiet — the user decides.
merge.debtBurnRule: A PR closing a 'debt-burn'-labelled issue auto-merges once CI is green AND the review loop ended in APPROVE, even when it touches source code. Decided by the user 2026-07-30 (see review-feedback: debt-burn-lane). Bigger themes stay human-gated — and a decision pending with the user must never block the debt-burn lane.
merge.refactorRule: A behaviour-preserving refactor PR auto-merges once CI is green AND the review loop ended in APPROVE, when ALL hold: no exported API shape changes (no symbol added/removed/re-signatured in any package's public surface), no semantic change (existing test assertion content unmodified; goldens/fixtures byte-identical), and the PR body proves both. Anything that bakes in the shape of functions, classes, or module APIs — new abstractions, symbol renames/removals, signature changes — stays human-gated. Decided by the user 2026-07-31 (PR #80 precedent: mechanical table extraction auto-mergeable; #77 C3 class conversion not).
